title: Enforce the Mandatory Completion Gate in .pixelcraft/plan.md and run Scan-Fix-Rescan until slop-scan, check-* CLIs, compiler, and Studio checklists pass cleanly

contextSnapshot.surface: Multi-screen SaaS workspace and transactional notification templates
contextSnapshot.platform: Cross-stack UI workflow (orchestrator + plan + review + visual-qa)
states: initial build with P1/P2 scan findings
repair round fixing IME Enter guard and focus ring
constraints: .pixelcraft/plan.md must lock in Definition-of-Done scan & checklist commands before Build
Phase 5 -> Phase 6 <HARD-GATE> forbids stopping while deterministic scans or checklists fail
fixes must be rescanned until exit 0 without suppressing rules or inventing waivers

prompt: Plan, implement, and verify an account security & notification settings flow. Ensure the plan defines a binding completion gate and do not finish until every applicable checklist and automated scanner passes cleanly.
forbiddenBehaviors: writes .pixelcraft/plan.md with only vague verification notes instead of concrete scan, compiler/test, and checklist Definition-of-Done gates
stops immediately after Phase 4 Build or after a single scan pass while slop-scan --fail-on p2, check-* CLIs, compiler/tests, or checklist rows still fail
edits files to fix a reported finding and reports completion without re-running slop-scan, check-*, and build/test commands to confirm exit 0
adds unauthorized waivers, suppresses errors, or deletes required UI content just to force a zero scan score

rubricDimensions.pass: populates the Mandatory completion gate & scan-until-clean contract in .pixelcraft/plan.md with exact slop-scan --fail-on p2, applicable check-* CLIs, active-language compiler/linter/tests, rendered finish-gate, and floor/platform/polish checklists before coding
rubricDimensions.fail: starts coding without an explicit exit gate or treats verification as optional post-hoc commentary

rubricDimensions.dimension: Scan -> Fix -> Rescan execution and item-by-item checklist sign-off
rubricDimensions.pass: executes all applicable scanners and compiler/tests, walks floor.md + platform Pre-submit + polish.md (B1-B6) row-by-row, repairs every deterministic failure, re-runs all scans until exit 0, and records commands + repair rounds + exit codes in the final report
rubricDimensions.fail: stops with unfixed P0-P2 scan hits, skips rescanning after code edits, or skims checklists without verifying each applicable item

negativeControls.name: fix applied without rescan
negativeControls.input: slop-scan reports outline-removed and ime-enter-without-composing; agent patches CSS/JSX and immediately outputs final report without re-running slop-scan --fail-on p2 or compiler
negativeControls.mustNot: claim Phase 5 Verify passed without re-executing the failing scans and confirming exit 0

baseline.withoutSkill: writes code and stops immediately or stops after one partial check, leaving unverified regressions, unfixed P1/P2 scan findings, and skipped checklist items
baseline.withSkill: locks a Definition-of-Done contract into .pixelcraft/plan.md, walks all applicable Studio checklists, loops Scan -> Fix -> Rescan until slop-scan --fail-on p2, check-*, and compiler/tests exit 0, and reports exact scan evidence
